latestVersion.changelog:
Version 0.3.1

- Added dedicated reference guides for Clean Architecture, MVI, MVVM, Reactive, TCA, VIPER, and an architecture selection guide.
- Improved handling for explicit architecture requests: perform a fit check, explain mismatches if any, and suggest the best-fit alternative.
- For mismatch cases, proceed with a risk-mitigated plan if the user insists, highlighting risks up front.
- Added output requirements to include fit results and rationale when an architecture is specified.
- Clarified when to reference selection guides and how to justify architecture recommendations.
- No changes to core deliverable structure or technical guidance flow.
